description: This registry's promoted backup-type enum has two members (backup:full-backup, backup:incremental-backup). cbbackupmgr-info.md's own command output states a backup's type field can be 'a full backup (FULL), and incremental backup (INCR) or a merge (MERGE)' - a third value the reference documentation for the merge command itself never states is a new backup TYPE rather than a full backup that happens to have been produced by merging. No promoted concept exists for it yet (filed as backup:merge-result, extraction-layer, 2 files).
